name: Iris
source: Another prostitute of the Golden Shackles. She is young and has a fragile appearance which contrasts sharply with her personality, as she casually insults people and uses foul language in a nearly unchanging monotone. [spoiler]Iris used to be a noble, but after she got thrown away by her family, she was forced to become a prostitute.[/spoiler]
